name: Tim Draper
what_they_do: Founder and Managing Partner, Draper Associates (San Mateo, CA). Also founded DFJ, Draper University, and hosts the pitch show Meet The Drapers.
stage: Draper Associates: 'primarily investing from pre-seed to Series A', describes itself as 'stage-agnostic'. Meet The Drapers accepts Pre-Seed to Series A startups.
check_size: $250k-$5M (secondary: superscout.co); vcsheet says $500K-$5M. Not stated on draper.vc.
geography: Global ('across sectors, geographies, and technologies'); HQ San Mateo, CA; secondary source says primarily North America
email_or_form: Pitch form: https://www.draper.vc/contact . Meet The Drapers apply: https://www.meetthedrapers.com/apply (search snippet also cites hello@meetthedrapers.com; apply page returned 403 on fetch)
outreach_rule: Submit via the pitch form at draper.vc/contact: PDF deck only, max 10MB, 'no confidential info please'; deck must cover 10 required sections (overview, problem, solution, offering, tech, monetization, customer delight, network effects, fundraising dynamics, team).
notes: Backs 'bold, visionary founders' in frontier tech; early bets on Tesla, SpaceX, Coinbase, Bitcoin. Meet The Drapers: 4 startups pitch per episode for up to $1M; sector-agnostic. X bio: 'Backing the bold ideas that shape the future'.

name: Charlie O'Donnell
what_they_do: Founder and GP of Brooklyn Bridge Ventures (fund stopped new investments in 2023). Now coaches founders on fundraising and pitches, coaches VCs, and runs nextNYC events. Writes 'This Is Going To Be Big'.
stage: NOT currently investing. LinkedIn headline: 'NO LONGER INVESTING IN STARTUPS'; site: 'After 20 years in venture, I'm taking a break from investing.' Historically pre-seed and seed in NYC companies that had raised under $750k.
sectors: generalist (historically hardware, food & beverage, media, transportation, education, e-commerce, health IT, SaaS, fintech)
email_or_form: https://www.brooklynbridge.vc/contact (fund contact page; fund is not investing)
outreach_rule: Not taking pitches for investment. Offers paid founder coaching and public events via nextNYC; historically known for open office hours.
notes: Flag: not a live pre-seed target as of 2026-09-02. Useful for pitch feedback, NYC ecosystem intros, and events.

name: Kunal Shah
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of CRED (Bengaluru). Prolific India angel with ~300 investments. Search snippet says his X bio now reads 'Head - WhatsApp Founder - CRED' (unverified).
stage: Signal: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A, Series B. Secondary sources describe a high-volume, small-cheque angel strategy.
check_size: Signal: $10K-$500K, sweet spot $100K. Other secondary sources cite $10K-$50K. Not self-published.
outreach_rule: unknown; no public pitch channel found
notes: Part-time YC partner and Sequoia India advisor in the past. His name on a cap table is a signal; invests small cheques across many startups. Most recent listed deal: Aina Computers seed (July 2026, per Tracxn snippet).

name: Nithin Kamath / Rainmatter
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of Zerodha; Rainmatter is Zerodha's Rs 1000 crore perpetual fund for Indian founders working on wealth and health.
stage: Stage-agnostic. Rainmatter: 'we think of businesses holistically in terms of people running the show'; patient long-term capital, no exit mandate, no board seats.
email_or_form: https://forms.gle/zg3QSsKpeBWqTgpy8 (Rainmatter apply form linked from rainmatter.com)
outreach_rule: Apply via the Google form on rainmatter.com.
notes: Rainmatter is the vehicle, not Nithin personally. Long-term, no quick exits, no board seats. Focus on companies that help Indians build wealth and health.

name: Kunal Bahl
what_they_do: Co-founder of Snapdeal; co-founder of Titan Capital (with Rohit Bansal), an operator-led early-stage fund; Shark on Shark Tank India.
stage: Titan Capital: 'operator-led early stage capital', typically the first investors. Secondary: friends & family / angel / pre-seed / seed / seed+ / Series A.
check_size: $300k-$500k initial cheques at pre-seed and seed (secondary: superscout.co, YourStory snippet). Not stated on titancapital.vc.
geography: India primarily; also Asia and global (portfolio in Australia, NZ, UK, Dubai, Singapore)
email_or_form: startups@titancapital.vc (published on https://www.titancapital.vc/contact-us/); student founders: https://forms.gle/xxJPtgpsMZJJY9Yz6
other_channels: Campus Chai monthly event for student founders
outreach_rule: Email startups@titancapital.vc with a pitch deck.
notes: Team is the number one criterion. 250+ startups backed (Ola, Urban Company, Razorpay, OfBusiness, Mamaearth). Says they stay with founders 15-20 years.

name: Varun Alagh
what_they_do: Co-founder and CEO of Honasa Consumer Ltd (Mamaearth), Gurugram. Angel investor with ~76 portfolio companies (Tracxn snippet).
stage: unknown; no public statement found. Portfolio suggests early-stage consumer/D2C angel.
notes: Notable angel bets: Shiprocket, The Sleep Company. LinkedIn URL confirmed on honasa.in founder page. X handle could not be verified (x.com and search budget blocked).

name: Packy McCormick
what_they_do: Writer of the Not Boring newsletter; solo GP of Not Boring Capital (Fund III). Biotech partner: Elliot Hershberg.
stage: vcsheet: Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A. Fund III announcement (per search snippet): primarily Seed through Series B, select pre-seed.
check_size: $100K-$2M (vcsheet); Signal: $100K-$10M, sweet spot $1M; Fund I deck cited ~$500k for pre-seed/seed. Secondary sources only.
outreach_rule: unknown; no public pitch channel found (notboring.co blocked on fetch)
notes: 'Solo GP + media flywheel': uses essays to source deals and amplify portfolio. Does not lead; minimal ownership; no board seats. Backs 'Worldbuilders' with ambitious long-term visions.

name: Nik Sharma
what_they_do: Founder and CEO of Sharma Brands (DTC growth agency, joining Lunar Solar Group); Venture Partner at Social Impact Capital; consumer angel (~19-20 investments).
email_or_form: unknown (sharmabrands.com has a business contact form, not a pitch form)
notes: Handle and LinkedIn come from Signal (secondary). Investments include Swishables, Heatmap, Stand+.

name: Arlan Hamilton
what_they_do: Founder and Managing Partner of Backstage Capital (Los Angeles); founder of Mor wealth-building social club; author and podcaster.
stage: vcsheet: Pre-Seed, Seed, Series A. Backstage apply page: 'We are not accepting new funding applications at this time.'
sectors: underrepresented founders (women, People of Color, LGBTQ)
email_or_form: https://backstagecapital.com/apply-2/ (closed to new applications on fetch); general contact form https://backstagecapital.com/contact/
outreach_rule: Backstage: 'We are not accepting new funding applications at this time. Check back in 2025.' No personal pitch rule found.
notes: 200 companies backed. Recent LinkedIn activity is about Mor membership and speaking, not new investing. Treat as low-probability target.

name: Li Jin
what_they_do: Co-founder and General Partner at Variant (crypto/web3 fund, NYC office; LinkedIn lists her in Austin, TX). Coined 'passion economy'.
stage: Signal: Pre-seed, Seed, Series A. vcsheet: Seed - Series A.
email_or_form: info [at] variant.fund and a contact form on https://variant.fund/
outreach_rule: Variant publishes info [at] variant.fund and a site contact form. No personal rule found.
notes: Signal notes she does not invest in hardware, D2C, CPG, or enterprise-sales-dependent companies. Variant does not lead (vcsheet). Variant site now says it backs 'technology that expands human autonomy'.

name: Shreyas Doshi
what_they_do: Startup advisor and product coach (founder, High Leverage Labs); ex-Stripe, Twitter, Google; angel investor since 2013; Board of Advisors at O'Shaughnessy Ventures.
stage: Signal lists Pre-Seed/Angel through later stages. LinkedIn shows 'Angel Investor 2013-2025', which may mean he paused angel investing.
notes: Only 8 investments on Signal record. Better known as a product thinker than as a high-volume angel. Handle from Signal (secondary).

name: Austen Allred
what_they_do: Founder of Gauntlet AI (Austin, TX); co-founder and CEO of BloomTech (Lambda School). Personal site says he invests in early-stage companies through the 'Austen Access Fund'.
stage: 'Early-stage tech startups' (austenallred.com); no more detail published.
notes: Handle verified from his personal site. Signal profile lists him as an investor but shows no criteria. LinkedIn does not mention the fund.

name: Danielle Strachman
what_they_do: Co-founder and General Partner, 1517 Fund. Founding director of the Thiel Fellowship; senior advisor to the Thiel Fellowship.
stage: Idea/R&D phase through seed (1517fund.com). 'Write in! We read all submissions.'
email_or_form: info@1517fund.com; 'Get in Touch' form on https://www.1517fund.com/
outreach_rule: 'Write in! We read all submissions. If we can help, we're usually in touch within a few days.' Use the form on 1517fund.com or info@1517fund.com.
notes: Backs 'dropouts working on hard problems & sci-fi scientists', founders without degrees. 'More about the who than the what.' Fund leads rounds. Early spotter of Vitalik Buterin and Dylan Field.

name: Lolita Taub
what_they_do: General Partner, Ganas Ventures, a community-driven pre-seed/seed fund for the US and Latin America.
outreach_rule: 'No warm intro needed'; apply via the form on ganas.vc.
notes: Portfolio: 90% BIPOC-led, 55% women-led, 50% Latine-led. Mexico 20%, Costa Rica & El Salvador 10%, Brazil 5%. Matching tool has made 10,000+ intros.
